title: Output probability after guaranteed halting
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $t,t'\in\mathbb{N}$ with $t\le t'$. If every choice word of length exactly $t$ leads to a halted configuration on input $x$, then for every binary output word $v$, the probability of outputting $v$ after $t'$ choices equals the probability of outputting $v$ after $t$ choices.
